simulation_brief.summary: Forecasting whether the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry official motivation will center on Research Area M, defined as metal-organic frameworks or closely equivalent porous crystalline framework chemistry. The field has strong long-run citations, applications, and multiple living senior pioneers, but the chemistry prize category rotates unpredictably across methods, materials, biological chemistry, applied discoveries, and other Nobel-plausible areas.
simulation_brief.endpoint_definition: Count yes only if official prize motivation centers on metal-organic frameworks or equivalent framework chemistry.
